title: TV systems with a ready-made download
description: One platform.json per TV system the maintainer builds and offers a download for (platforms/<id>/platform.json). The table 'Which TVs work?' in README.md, README.de.md and on the website is generated from these files by tools/spec_gen.js (npm run spec). Apps that other people build for their TVs are listed in ports.json instead (links only). There is one app for all media servers: a new server type is added to the same app (field mediaServers), never as a separate variant.

name.description: Readable name of the TV system, e.g. 'Samsung Smart TV 2014 (Orsay)'. Must not contain 'Plex'.

modelFamilies.description: Model families or years, with examples. Never serial numbers or anything personal.

de.description: Optional German wording for the German README (README.de.md); missing = the English text is used.

osVersions.description: TV operating system(s) and version(s), e.g. 'webOS 6.0'.

route.description: web = the shared ES5 core in the TV's browser engine (src/ unchanged, thin adapter); native = own source tree that reuses the logic modules (PORTING-WITH-AI.md).

type.description: How the app gets onto the TV.

needsAccount.description: Account the TV or the developer tool needs, in plain words.

expires.description: Does the installation expire (e.g. developer mode sessions)? Plain words.

computerNeededAfterInstall.description: Must a computer keep running after the installation?

format.description: setup-program = a program for the computer that contains the TV app and installs it (2014 Samsung); otherwise the TV package format.

name.description: Download file name; {slug} is the brand slug (e.g. 'neolume'), {os}/{arch} the computer for a setup program. Names of existing downloads never change.

mediaServers.description: Media servers this one app works with on that TV.

editions.description: Optional. Leave it out: the system is offered everywhere.

public.description: false = not offered in the release (yet). Leave the field out to offer it.

private.description: false = left out of other builds. Leave the field out normally.

status.description: maintainer-tested = checked on a real TV by the maintainer; community-tested = test-plan results of a contributor, not checked by the maintainer; experimental = builds, not fully tested, no download in 'latest'; planned = not built yet.

version.description: App version last tested on a real TV.

model.description: Model used for the test (only as already named in the public docs).

testPlan.description: full = the whole TEST-PLAN.md; release = the release test (sections 1 and 2, the areas the release touches, the benchmark); smoke = start, play, back.

en.description: Installation guide in English (path in the public tree). Samsung 2014 keeps docs/INSTALL.md; new systems use docs/install/<id>.md.

maintainer.description: GitHub handle of whoever looks after this system, without @.

features.description: Status per Part A section of SPEC.md (A1 … A19), like ports.json.

notes.description: Optional short note (not shown in the table).
